purpose: macOS development HDR verification; project SDK recipes and archive hashes are locked in sdk-dependencies.json
platform: Product deployment target macOS 14 or newer; project SDKs are built for the selected macOS architecture

libplacebo.checks: Exact pkg-config version, compile-time API 360, runtime patch 1

MoltenVK.checks: Compile-time version and runtime Vulkan driver ID/version

developmentToolchain.shaderc: 2026.4, built from locked source with libplacebo; see sdk-dependencies.json

packagingBoundary: Project SDKs include their locked runtime dependencies and license files. Publishing collects dependency closure, copies notices, rewrites Mach-O paths, and signs the app. No system Vulkan ICD is used to choose the renderer.
